speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic use. The combination of recent antibiotic treatment, new flank pain, fever, elevated inflammatory markers and creatinine, alongside a temporal rash that resolved with medication change, strongly supports this diagnosis while ruling out obstructive causes.
